sections.voiceover: Harvard research found that ten specific negotiation tactics win better outcomes.
On October 6, 2026, Katie Shonk detailed integrative bargaining skills for the Program on Negotiation. What strategies do Harvard experts recommend for workplace negotiations?
Except Luis Reyes warned that hard-bargaining tactics often fail during professional negotiations.

Katie Shonk explains that integrative bargaining replaces aggressive posturing with collaborative problem-solving. Luis Reyes shows how professionals mastering these 10 tactics improve their office results. Harvard's Program on Negotiation creates lasting agreements instead of temporary wins.
Harvard identifies 10 tactics for achieving better professional outcomes.
